title: Add Destructive Variant to Button Component
description: Create a new 'destructive' variant in the Button component using the new Tailwind color utilities.
details: In components/ui/button.tsx, update the buttonVariants object managed by cva to include a 'destructive' variant. This variant should use the classes: 'bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90'. Ensure the variant is accessible and compatible with both light and dark themes.
test_strategy: Render the Button component with variant='destructive' in Storybook or a test page, and visually inspect for correct color, hover, and focus states in both light and dark modes. Use accessibility tools to check color contrast.

title: Apply Destructive Variant to Target Button on Landing Page
description: Update the primary CTA button on the landing page to use the new 'destructive' variant.
details: In app/page.tsx, locate the primary call-to-action Button instance (e.g., 'Sign Up' or similar) and change its variant prop to 'destructive'. Ensure the button's appearance now reflects the new red style and that it remains prominent and accessible.
test_strategy: Load the landing page in the browser and confirm the CTA button displays with the new red style in both light and dark modes. Test responsiveness and keyboard accessibility. Use a color contrast checker to verify compliance with WCAG AA.

title: Define Red Color Variables in Global CSS
description: Add new CSS variables for the red button color scheme in both light and dark modes within app/globals.css.
details: Edit app/globals.css to introduce new CSS variables for the red color scheme. Under :root, define --destructive and --destructive-foreground for light mode. Under .dark, provide appropriate values for dark mode. Example: --destructive: 0 84.2% 60.2%; --destructive-foreground: 210 40% 98%. Ensure the color values provide high contrast and meet accessibility standards.
test_strategy: Verify that the CSS variables are correctly defined and available in both light and dark modes by inspecting the computed styles in the browser's dev tools.

title: Update Tailwind Config with New Color Variables
description: Expose the new red color variables to Tailwind CSS by updating tailwind.config.js.
details: Modify tailwind.config.js to add the new 'destructive' and 'destructive-foreground' colors to the Tailwind theme. Use hsl(var(--destructive)) and hsl(var(--destructive-foreground)) for the color values. This ensures the new colors can be used as Tailwind utility classes throughout the app.
test_strategy: Run the Tailwind CLI build process and confirm that the new color utilities (bg-destructive, text-destructive-foreground) are generated and available in the output CSS.
